name: Sorcerous Follow-up (Combat)
body:
You can distract or cow your foes before inflicting your spells upon them.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +5, the ability to cast 2nd level spells.

Benefit: If you make a successful melee attack against a creature, you gain a +1 bonus to the save DC of the first spell you use against that same target before the end of your next turn. This bonus can apply to multiple creatures if you made multiple successful attacks. For example if a character with multiple iterative attacks hit 3 creatures on their turn, on the following turn if they cast fireball the increased save DC would apply to any of those creatures in the spell’s area .
